VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence shows tests pass (criterion 2), but provides no proof that the actual race condition was fixed (criterion 1). A passing test suite only confirms criterion 1 if there is a specific test that reproduces the token-refresh race and now passes—race conditions are notoriously prone to passing intermittently or being untested entirely. Without a diff showing the fix and a targeted test demonstrating the race is resolved, criterion 1 is unverified.
